effects.tier3: 5 damage; M < 2 [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) if size 1, or [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (save ends) otherwise

features.name: Rotting Fist
features.target: One creature or object per minion

effects.effect: When the rotting zombie is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), their space is [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain). The first time any enemy who has M < 2 enters this space, they are [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (save ends) and the effect ends.
